confidence_notes: Food estimates use Puerto Iguazú cost ranges and Argentina-wide price data as a July 2026 approximation. Accommodation is a holistic estimate based on the city's tourism demand; no live booking prices were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food anchors use Puerto Iguazú city-level cost ranges, checked against Argentina-wide restaurant prices. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of a year-round waterfall tourism destination.
